name: n8n-hubspot-custom-code-action-error-handler
description: Centralized n8n error handler for HubSpot workflow custom code actions: parses stack traces and API errors, alerts Slack, logs to Datadog or the console, and triggers retry or fallback protocols.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems)

scripts.lint: node --check error-parser.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check hubspot/custom-code-wrapper.js && node --check test/error-parser.test.js && node --check test/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:check && npm test
